custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the texture of the meat. AI often struggles with the specific granular look of ground meat, sometimes making it look too smooth or like a solid mass with painted-on texture. Check if the glaze looks like a liquid coating or just a colored layer. Verify that the flecks inside look like distinct ingredients (onions/breadcrumbs) rather than noise.
